parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can view the AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 500. Valid values: any integer from 1 to 500.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

> The start time must be within the last 7 days.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the callback is successful. Valid values:
- success: Successful.
- failed: Failed.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.
